title: Show spotlight: “A Ghost in Your Ear” playing at Audible’s Minetta La...
transcript: This horror play is experienced through a pair of headphones. And going into it, I wasn't really sure what to expect from this concept. I knew that there were two live actors, but I wasn't exactly sure how much of the show I would be watching versus just listening. And having now seen it, I think it's a really fascinating blend of both. The basic premise is that you are watching this man, played by Lucas Iverson from the pit, record this audiobook version of a horror story. And as he is doing this, some spooky things start to happen to him as well. And this format has a few things going for it. The first is that it allows Lucas Iverson to really go for it. Not only does he play multiple characters in this story, but he is also giving a surprisingly physical performance for someone who is just in a sound booth recording an audiobook. And part of that is because of the second thing, which is that they're using spatial audio. So if the actor is on the right side of the stage, the sound is going to come through predominantly on your right ear. If he's on the left side of the stage, it's gonna come through your left ear. If he's above the mic, below the mic, far away from the mic, close to the mic, this all changes the way that you are hearing the sound. And both he and writer/director Jamie Armitage, have a lot of fun with this concept. I also thought the headphones gave it a very specific intimacy in that it provides this separation from you and the rest of the audience, which I actually thought made the experience much scarier because it removes the communal experience of it all. You feel isolated and alone, and that is always going to be scarier than feeling the safety of a crowd. All that to say, this play is pretty scary. And while it is primarily a story told through audio, there are quite a few visual scares as well that I thought were pretty well executed. So if you like horror and spooky things, especially with Halloween coming up, then you're probably gonna Wanna check this one out.
